g.title: ODS
g.text: Osmotic Demyelination Syndrome (ODS) — QSP mechanistic map
the kidney sets the rate, the astrocyte decides whether it can withstand that rate, and the oligodendrocyte pays the price
OMEGA = ORG_set(Osm_eff) - ORG = the organic osmolyte deficit = the disease

g.title: cluster_aeti
g.text: ① Aetiological phenotype — the same sodium, a different kidney

g.title: cluster_avp
g.text: ② The AVP axis (Osmoreceptor · baroreceptor · V2)

g.title: cluster_renal
g.text: ③ Renal water and solute handling (the machine that sets the RATE)

g.title: cluster_rvd
g.text: ⑥ Hypotonic adaptation · RVD (regulatory volume decrease) — this is fast

g.title: cluster_rvi
g.text: ⑦ Re-adaptation during correction · RVI — inorganic ions are fast, organic osmolytes are slow

g.title: cluster_org
g.text: ⑧ The organic osmolyte pool (what MRS can see) — normal total 48 mOsm/kg brain water

g.title: cluster_astro
g.text: ⑩ Astrocyte energetics and death (the first target)

g.title: cluster_inflam
g.text: ⑪ Neuroinflammation and blood-brain barrier breakdown

g.title: cluster_oli
g.text: ⑫ Oligodendrocytes and myelin (victims, not the target)

g.title: cluster_topo
g.text: ⑬ Lesion topography — why the pons of all places

g.title: cluster_img
g.text: ⑮ Imaging and biomarkers — the imaging lags the symptoms

g.title: cluster_rx1
g.text: ⑯ Treatment ① the means of raising the sodium

g.title: cluster_rx2
g.text: ⑰ Treatment ② the means of governing the rate (this is the real treatment)

g.title: cluster_rx3
g.text: ⑱ Adjunctive and experimental therapy (all preclinical or case-level)

g.title: cluster_risk
g.text: ⑲ Risk modifiers — they all converge on transporter capacity

g.title: cluster_cf
g.text: ⑳ The central experiment of this model (the one switch)

g.text: cortisol deficiency → failure to suppress AVP

g.text: (the driving force of the Na-coupled transporters)

g.text: ★ the quantity that actually sets the correction rate ★

g.title: OMEGA
g.text: ★ the disease variable of this model ★
normal 0 · adapted brain 0 · >0 only during correction

g.title: ADAPT
g.text: brain water normal + 40% of osmolytes lost

g.title: ASYM
g.text: giving it away: a channel (t½ 6 h)

g.text: the only measure that reads adaptation and recovery directly

g.title: RECOV
g.text: a substantial fraction of survivors (over months)

g.title: GWINT
g.text: (the lattice of transverse and longitudinal fibres)

g.title: SPARE
g.text: Pontine tegmentum and subpial rim spared

g.title: MRINEG
g.text: ★ the MRI can be normal at symptom onset ★

g.title: NS09
g.text: if U_osm > 308 it worsens the hyponatraemia

g.title: PROACT
g.text: stop the kidney from the outset and

g.title: RESCUE->OMEGA
g.text: brings Ω back below the threshold

g.title: CF1
g.text: Same patient · same fluid · same prescription

g.title: CF2
g.text: AVP held at its value on presentation

g.title: CF4
g.text: The difference between the two arms IS the disease
